business_problem: Asten Santé needed to automate labor-intensive budget construction and analysis across diverse healthcare activities, repeated five times per year for La Poste Group reporting, while improving the reliability and security of financial planning data.
solution_summary: Asten Santé built a modular performance management environment with IBM Planning Analytics and IBM Cognos Analytics, implemented over more than three years with partner Next Decision. The first module connected to SAGE so actual accounting data could feed analytical income statements and budget construction. Additional modules pulled activity data from Isadom to project sales and patient demand, modeled patient consumption to estimate needs and margins, and added CAPEX forecasting for assets. Together, Cognos and Planning Analytics turned these source systems into a repeatable budgeting and reporting stack for management and operational teams, replacing repeated spreadsheet work. The design was iterative and workshop-driven, allowing each module to be created around Asten Santé's own specifications while steadily expanding the platform into a broader steering tool.

solution_components.name: IBM Planning Analytics
solution_components.role: Runs the budgeting, forecasting and module-based planning workflows used by management and operational teams.

solution_components.name: IBM Cognos Analytics
solution_components.role: Provides analysis and reporting capabilities on top of the planning environment.

data_flow: Accounting actuals from SAGE and operational activity data from Isadom feed Planning Analytics modules for income statements, sales projections, patient consumption and CAPEX planning, and Cognos Analytics exposes the resulting budget and analysis reports to business teams.
business_outcome: Asten Santé accelerated recurring budget cycles, improved the reliability and security of planning data, and gave teams a more flexible decision-support environment for sales, patient demand and asset planning.
architecture_clues: The implementation began with an accounting module and expanded module by module.
SAGE provides actual data while Isadom contributes business activity data.
The platform supports both management-control and operational team use cases.
